title: Keep a stand-in limit nobody set from running

blocks.text: When an issuer can't be reached, your switch approves small purchases in stand-in, up to a limit that operations set per server through two environment variables, `STANDIN_MAX` (in minor units) and `STANDIN_CURRENCY`. The limit is a QBean, `StandInLimit`, and its descriptor is in the comment at the top of `src/main/java/com/example/practice/StandInLimit.java`.
Last month a new server went live without `STANDIN_MAX`. The QBean started, every stand-in purchase was declined for a week, and nothing in `deploy/` looked wrong. Operations ask for this:

items: a limit nobody set, or one that isn't a whole number of minor units, must not run, and an operator listing `deploy/` must see which file is wrong;
without `STANDIN_CURRENCY`, the limit is in US dollars (`840`).

blocks.text: The tests deploy your QBean with a real Q2 in the test's JVM, on a scratch deploy directory, and then look at the directory and at the QBean's state in JMX. Neither variable is set where they run.

cases.says: a descriptor with an amount and a currency deploys, and the limit approves up to that amount in that currency
an amount whose variable is not set counts as absent, so the limit does not run and its file is renamed .BAD
a refused descriptor is renamed .BAD at deploy, rather than left in place with a bean that never starts
an amount that is not a whole number is refused, not replaced by a value that keeps the bean running
an optional value whose variable is not set gets its default, 840, not an empty string

origin.section: 14.3 A Configuration Refused in `setConfiguration` Renames the File; Refused Later, It Only Logs

concepts: A missing property, a misspelt name and an unresolved ${...} all count as absent: a @Config field keeps its initialiser and get returns an empty string, so a value with no safe default must have none.
A ConfigurationException from setConfiguration renames the descriptor .BAD and leaves no bean registered, while a refusal in initService leaves the file in place and the bean Unknown.
